properties.name: value
properties.comment: The current value (Value), within minimum and maximum; anything else, or a value that is not finite, throws std::out_of_range. A change shows it in the editor and raises value_changed.
hand: prepare refuses a value outside the range; written shows it in the editor, invalidates and raises value_changed

properties.name: minimum
properties.comment: The lowest value (Minimum). A minimum above maximum raises maximum to it, and value is clamped into the range (raising value_changed), in that order. A value that is not finite throws std::invalid_argument.

table.description: The lowest value; a minimum above the maximum raises the maximum to it, and the value is clamped into the range.

hand: prepare refuses a value that is not finite; written raises maximum to it when needed, clamps value and invalidates

properties.name: maximum
properties.comment: The highest value (Maximum). A maximum below minimum lowers minimum to it, and value is clamped into the range (raising value_changed), in that order. A value that is not finite throws std::invalid_argument.

table.description: The highest value; a maximum below the minimum lowers the minimum to it, and the value is clamped into the range.

hand: prepare refuses a value that is not finite; written lowers minimum to it when needed, clamps value and invalidates

properties.name: increment
properties.comment: How far one step moves the value (Increment); it must be finite and positive, or std::invalid_argument is thrown.

table.description: How far one step moves the value; finite and positive.

prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("NumericUpDown increment must be finite and positive");

properties.name: decimal_places
properties.comment: How many decimal places the editor shows (DecimalPlaces), at most 12 (std::invalid_argument). Any decimal places turn hexadecimal off.

table.description: Decimal places the editor shows, at most 12; any turn hexadecimal off.

hand: prepare refuses more than 12; written turns hexadecimal off, then shows the value

properties.name: hexadecimal
properties.comment: Whether the editor shows the value in hexadecimal (Hexadecimal); turning it on sets decimal_places to zero.
hand: written sets decimal_places to zero when on, then shows the value

properties.name: button_width
properties.comment: The width of the arrow buttons, 12 to 64 (std::out_of_range otherwise).
prepare: throw std::out_of_range("NumericUpDown button width must be finite and between 12 and 64");

properties.name: scrub
properties.comment: Whether a press and sideways drag on the unfocused field scrubs the value (the shared scrub gesture, value bar study 3.2), a click still focusing the field with its text selected. Off by default: the field then edits as a TextBox does.

table.description: Drag sideways on the unfocused field to scrub the value.

not_properties.name: set_range
not_properties.reason: writes minimum then maximum together, refusing an unordered pair (std::invalid_argument); kept as a method beside the minimum and maximum properties, whose writes in either order reach the same range
